language_task: Pick up the ball and place it in the bowl.
outcome_evidence: At frame 0, camera_high shows the orange ball beside the blue bowl. Frames 138–200 in camera_wrist_right and camera_high show the gripper acquiring the ball and carrying it toward the bowl. Frames 283–320 in camera_wrist_right show the fingers opening and the ball settling into the bowl. By frame 340, camera_high shows the gripper withdrawn and the ball inside the bowl; this state persists through frame 749. No failed attempt or unintended side effect is visible.
